FC-1A.title: Figure C-1A: Failure Envelopes (Maximum Shear Stress vs. Normal Stress) (printed C-2, PDF 116)
FC-1A.legend_hint: see the notes on this figure
FC-1A.notes_for_reviewers: Failure envelopes of RS soil: maximum shear stress against normal stress for three density groups. Open circles Dr .50 to .57 (45.5 degrees), filled circles Dr .73 to .88 (47 degrees), triangles Dr 1.0 to 1.16 (51 degrees; drawn pointing down although the legend shows them up). Two open circles and one filled circle sit on another group's line; their group is settled by the data sheets. The triangle on the axis at zero normal stress is a real test.

FC-2A.notes_for_reviewers: Failure envelopes of PS soil. The printed legend is swapped: the squares are the dense tests (Dr 1.15 to 1.3, 49.5 degrees) and the circles the loose tests (Dr .33 to .53, 46.7 degrees), as the data sheets FC-2B and FC-2C show.
